$comment: The curator's answer: decisions, not a document. curator/apply.mjs turns these into the next focus.json. Enforced twice — the API constrains the response to this schema (runners/claude.sh --json-schema) and applyOps re-checks every op. Keep it inside the structured-output subset: anyOf (oneOf is rejected), additionalProperties false on every object, no minLength/maxLength/minimum.

ops.description: Every change to make, applied in order. Empty means the board is right as it stands. An item you do not name in an op is left untouched.

anyOf.title: add
anyOf.description: Put a new item on the board. Code sets its id, created and updated; it starts open.

title.description: the action the user takes; at most 200 characters

external_id.description: dedup key: thread id, event id, repo path, note path

meta.description: display line of facts, e.g. 'Gmail · Lauren · asked 9/22'

anyOf.title: update
anyOf.description: Change an open item in place. Fields you leave out are untouched.

anyOf.title: expire
anyOf.description: Take an open item off the surface: it went stale rather than getting done (§6). Say why in meta.

anyOf.title: reopen
anyOf.description: Put an item you previously expired back on the board, rather than adding a duplicate (§6). Only an expired item can be reopened.

anyOf.title: done
anyOf.description: Close an open item as finished, on evidence you can point to (§6). Never use this for something that merely went quiet.
